title: galarhoeus pilosus
intro: Galarhoeus pilosus, commonly known as Himalayan spurge or Himalayan sandalwood, is a species of flowering plant in the family Euphorbiaceae. It is a medicinal plant traditionally used in Ayurvedic and Unani medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Galarhoeus pilosus include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its ability to reduce inflammation, protect against oxidative stress, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are used to treat a range of health conditions.
